card.name: Suicidality in antidepressant warnings
card.fires_on: The 'id' inside 'suicidality' in antidepressant warning text about worsening depression. Also fires on a comma or letter within boxed-warning wording on suicidal thinking in young patients.

modes.label: Inside suicidality
modes.description: The 'id' piece in the word suicidality, after antidepressants are said to induce worsening of depression.

modes.label: Boxed warning wording
modes.description: A comma or letter in the list of ages or the disorder name within the suicide-risk warning.
modes.example: suicidal thinking and behavior in children, adolescents<<,>> and young adults taking antidepressants
